claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.container
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Bag of Holding is primarily a stateful extradimensional container, not an always-on grant, activated ability, triggered reaction, or summon. The surface needs a family that can own storage capacity, interior space, carried-weight invariance, retrieval procedure, and breathable-air tracking without lying about them as combat effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: container_breach_and_extradimensional_collapse
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item also has deterministic event-triggered failure modes tied to container state and cross-item interaction. Current passive mechanics only support grants and elapsed-time operations; they cannot express overload, piercing/tearing, turning inside out, or nesting inside another extradimensional space and then resolving destruction plus area transport.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane.
